# Europe is in a dilemma.

The concept of the "China shock 2.0" is receiving particular attention from European policymakers. While previously, cheap goods from China primarily pressured traditional manufacturing sectors, the competitive pressure has now spread to advanced industrial sectors, which are traditionally European strengths.
